notes.title: Screen Resolution and Linux Patch
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

I am sorry that some of you had issues with running the game on Linux, the latest patch should fix this. Please forgive me, I am not very experienced with Linux.

I also adjusted the screen resolution settings in Unity, so this should work now as well. The UI does not fit in every screen ratio, so if your screen is less wide than 16 : 9, you have to use window mode for now.

notes.title: Gameplay tutorial
notes.content: I see that players have trouble understanding how the game works, due to a missing in-game tutorial. Because of that, I made a short video to explain the core game mechanics. You can watch it here on Steam, or on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1r9eMCIUGwQ
